note: THE SOURCE for the company's site. Every fact the site states about the company is said here, once. What it states about the product - the principles, the commands, the version - is the engine's, read from the release requirements-engine.txt pins, and never typed here. A null is a fact not decided yet: the page leaves out what depends on it.

site.title: Wherefore — a company that compiles
site.description: Say each fact once. Wherefore generates every asset from it, and refuses any change that would leave one stale.
site.draft_banner: Nothing on this page is launched, and nothing here is a promise yet.

hero.headline: Run your company like it compiles.
hero.lede: Say each fact once. Wherefore generates every asset from it — the drawings, the pages, the parts lists, the documents — and refuses any change that would leave one of them stale. Nothing ships that contradicts a decision.

steps.name: Say it once
steps.text: Prices, dimensions, names and claims live in one source. Nothing else is allowed to type them.

steps.name: Generate the rest
steps.text: Plain scripts turn the source into every asset a customer, a supplier or a buyer sees. The same source makes the same files every time, because nothing in the build calls a model.

steps.name: Gate every change
steps.text: Before a change lands, the gate rebuilds everything and compares it with what is committed. Every file must be generated, written by a person, or a capture stamped with what it was made from — and every generated file must be current — or the change is refused, in words that say why.

steps.name: Prove the checks
steps.text: Each check has a proof that plants the fault it exists to catch and requires the check to name it. A check nobody has seen fail is not trusted.

client.heading: Built inside a real company
client.text: Wherefore was extracted from Chaotic Pendulums, where one spec file makes every drawing, solid model, parts list and web page. Move a dimension and every one of them moves with it, or the build stops and names the file that did not.

interface.heading: The whole interface
interface.lede: A command line, Python's standard library, and one file that says what your corpus is.

colophon: This page is generated by Wherefore from one source file, and checked by it.
